title: Loppu hyvä, kaikki hyvä
summary: "Loppu hyvä, kaikki hyvä" by William Shakespeare is a comedy published in 1623. Helena, a lowborn physician's daughter, loves the nobleman Bertram, who dismisses her. When she cures the King of France, she wins the right to choose a husband—Bertram himself. But he refuses to truly accept her unless she completes seemingly impossible tasks: bear his child and obtain his family ring. Through wit and determination, Helena pursues these challenges across France and Italy, navigating deception, disguise, and the question of whether love can be forced or earned.
